# Know your lead before you say hello.

Drop in a LinkedIn profile. Lead Qualifier researches the person across the web, builds a full dossier, and drafts outreach in their voice — so every first message lands.

### One link in

Start from a LinkedIn URL. Add X or GitHub for a sharper read — or import a whole CSV at once.

### A full dossier out

Company & funding, tech footprint, social voice, warm intro paths, and why they'd actually buy.

### Outreach, drafted

A multi-touch sequence written in their tone. Edit inline, regenerate, tag, and send.

## Stop sending cold templates.

Research the person, not the persona. Your first message should sound like you actually paid attention.
